available_workloads.name: ts-head
available_workloads.description: Time-series head-delete: inserts append at monotone tail, deletes only remove from head. Delete rate = KVSTORE_DELETE_RATE (default 1.0 = stationary window). Read() on a key below head MUST return false; Read() on a key in [head, tail) MUST succeed -- the harness spot-checks both after the run.

benchmark_execution.load_phase: Populate the store with all initial keys before the timed run
benchmark_execution.timed_run_phase: Run operations for 30 seconds, measure total ops completed
